parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'conversations_today', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE),
  'conversations_this_week', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)),
  'conversations_this_month', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)),
  'avg_response_time_seconds', COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (first_response_at - created_at)))::numeric, 2) FROM tickets WHERE first_response_at IS NOT NULL), 0),
  'avg_resolution_time_seconds', COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at)))::numeric, 2) FROM tickets WHERE status = 'resolved'), 0),
  'tickets_by_priority', (SELECT COALESCE(json_object_agg(priority, cnt), '{}'::json) FROM (SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tickets GROUP BY priority) s),
  'tickets_by_status', (SELECT COALESCE(json_object_agg(status, cnt), '{}'::json) FROM (SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tickets GROUP BY status) s),
  'tickets_by_category', (SELECT COALESCE(json_object_agg(cat_name, cnt), '{}'::json) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(tc.name, 'uncategorized') as cat_name, COUNT(t.id) as cnt FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN ticket_categories tc ON t.category_id = tc.id GROUP BY tc.name) s),
  'channel_distribution', (SELECT COALESCE(json_object_agg(channel, cnt), '{}'::json) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(channel, 'webchat') as channel, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM conversations GROUP BY channel) s),
  'csat_average', COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 2) FROM csat_surveys), 0),
  'escalation_rate', COALESCE((SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'urgent')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 2) FROM tickets), 0),
  'agent_performance', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'agent_id', a.id,
      'name', a.name,
      'role', a.role,
      'team', a.team,
      'status', a.status,
      'tickets_assigned', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.assigned_agent_id = a.id),
      'tickets_resolved', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.assigned_agent_id = a.id AND t.status = 'resolved'),
      'avg_response_time_seconds', COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.first_response_at - t.created_at)))::numeric, 2) FROM tickets t WHERE t.assigned_agent_id = a.id AND t.first_response_at IS NOT NULL), 0)
    )), '[]'::json) FROM agents a)
) AS metrics;
